tagline.en: Built for sterilization. Designed for reliable identification.
tagline.zh: 耐受严苛灭菌工艺，保障可靠识别。

positioning.en: Engineered for medical devices, pharmaceutical packaging, laboratory samples, and healthcare applications, our Sterilization Label Solutions are designed to withstand demanding sterilization processes while maintaining reliable identification from production to clinical use.
positioning.zh: ETIA 灭菌标签解决方案专为医疗器械、制药、实验室及医疗健康行业设计，可耐受高温蒸汽、干热、辐照、环氧乙烷及化学灭菌等多种灭菌工艺，在生产、灭菌、仓储及临床使用全过程保持稳定识别。

intro.en: Every sterilization process presents unique challenges to label materials. Selecting the right label construction helps maintain secure adhesion, durable print quality, and barcode readability throughout repeated sterilization, storage, transportation, and clinical workflows.
intro.zh: 不同灭菌工艺会对标签产生不同影响，包括高温、湿热、辐照及化学介质等挑战。针对不同灭菌方式选择合适的标签结构，可持续保持牢固粘接、清晰打印及条码可读性，满足医疗产品全生命周期追溯要求。

en: Reliable adhesion after repeated sterilization cycles
Durable thermal transfer print and barcode readability
Designed for medical, laboratory, and pharmaceutical applications
zh: 多次灭菌后依然保持稳定粘接
条码及热转印打印持久清晰
面向医疗、实验室及制药行业
满足产品追溯与法规合规要求

en.title: Steam Autoclave
en.desc: Steam sterilization combines high temperature, pressure, and moisture, requiring labels that resist heat, humidity, and repeated sterilization cycles.

en.title: Dry Heat Sterilization
en.desc: Dry heat sterilization exposes labels to prolonged high temperatures without moisture, demanding excellent heat resistance and long-term print durability.

en.title: Gamma Irradiation
en.desc: Gamma rays sterilize packaged products without heat but can embrittle films, fade print, and weaken adhesives if labels are not radiation resistant.

en.title: Ethylene Oxide (EtO)
en.desc: EtO sterilization is ideal for heat-sensitive medical devices. Labels must remain bonded and readable throughout gas sterilization and aeration cycles.

en.title: Chemical Sterilants
en.desc: Repeated exposure to disinfectants and sterilizing chemicals requires labels that resist chemical attack while preserving print quality and adhesion.
en.chemicals: Bleach • Ethanol • Peracetic Acid • Hydrogen Peroxide

zh.title: 高压蒸汽灭菌
zh.desc: 高压蒸汽灭菌结合高温、压力及湿热环境，标签需耐受反复蒸汽灭菌循环。

zh.title: 干热灭菌
zh.desc: 适用于持续高温环境，要求标签具有优异耐热性能及长期打印稳定性。

zh.title: 伽马辐照灭菌
zh.desc: 伽马射线可穿透包装完成灭菌，但普通标签可能出现脆化、褪色或胶粘失效。

zh.title: 环氧乙烷（EtO）灭菌
zh.desc: 适用于不耐高温医疗器械，标签需耐受 EtO 灭菌及解析全过程。

zh.title: 化学灭菌与表面消毒
zh.desc: 适用于长期接触消毒剂及灭菌化学品的医疗环境，保持标签粘接和打印稳定。
zh.chemicals: 漂白剂 • 乙醇 • 过氧乙酸 • 过氧化氢
